titre: The detailed programme reads module by module. Each step has a clear objective.
intro: Five modules progressively build your command of SAP Ariba. Here is their full content.
telechargerPdf: Download the programme as a PDF

modules.objectifPedagogique: Master the SAP Ariba environment and navigate the tool efficiently
modules.casPratique: Carry out a first walkthrough of SAP Ariba and find the information needed for a purchase requisition.
objectifs: Understand the environment and the main modules
contenu: Discover the interface and its key features
Identify the main data and documents

modules.objectifPedagogique: Carry out the main purchasing operations in SAP Ariba
modules.casPratique: Handle a purchase requisition from end to end, from its creation to tracking the order.
objectifs: Create and manage a purchase requisition
Track the different stages of the process
contenu: Manage receipts and the main stages of the process

modules.objectifPedagogique: Keep effective track of suppliers in SAP Ariba
modules.casPratique: Search for a supplier, review their information and check what is needed for an order.
contenu: Search for and select a supplier

modules.objectifPedagogique: Improve the visibility and oversight of purchasing activities
modules.casPratique: Analyse the tracking of several orders, spot an anomaly and decide which actions to take.
objectifs: Make use of the available data and indicators
contenu: Make use of the available data

modules.objectifPedagogique: Become faster, more self-sufficient and more reliable in using SAP Ariba
modules.casPratique: Solve a complete purchasing case by applying best practices to work faster and more reliably.
objectifs: Speed up the processing of requisitions and orders
contenu: Practical cases drawn from real work situations
Hands-on scenario and validation of learning
